exceptions.necessity: The test executes conditions extracted from the checked Makefile against a deliberately broken gate to prove the guard still runs. Its executable argument is derived test input, bound to the complete consumer AST digest.
exceptions.alternative: Replacing execution with a text assertion would miss a condition that silently skips the guard. Literal duplication would stop testing the actual recipe.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the Make recipe extraction can be reconstructed by the executable-payload adapter without granting arbitrary input.

exceptions.necessity: The port test executes the reviewer-verified .mjs inline queries, extracted verbatim at test time, to prove the core port's output is byte-identical. Its executable argument is derived test input bound to this file's AST digest.
exceptions.alternative: A static copy of the queries would reintroduce the drift the port exists to remove; a text assertion would not prove byte identity.
exceptions.removal: Remove when site-split-22 rewires the .mjs callers to the port and this equivalence test is replaced by the single-source assertion.
